feasibility_note: Full pipeline (3.40ms) < analysis window (10ms). Real-time monitoring is feasible on a single CPU core. The system analyzes every 10ms window with 3× margin.

llm_anomaly_explanation.note: LLM invoked ONLY on anomaly detection events (not every window). At p99 FPR <1%, this means ~few calls per hour in steady-state operation. Estimated from zero-shot eval timing: ~5s per call (API latency dominant). Acceptable for human-in-the-loop debugging workflow.
